summary: Both retained defects are resolved. All 16 source banks replay; 181 records pass independent math checks, 1,690 native grading checks pass, and 21 UI renders pass. All five runner items survive delivery without a demonstrated shortcut. Package unchanged; no database writes.

source_replay.details: All 16 complete keyed banks, prompts, solutions and correct values replay. Both retained checks fail on the previous package and pass on the revision.

math.details: Independent exact checks pass for 181 records, including all runner items and controlled counterfactuals.

variety.details: Every profile supports five different correct targets with its visible bank fixed. Delivery and selection preserve tested variation. No affected stored generated instance was demonstrated.

scope.details: The three source operation families, difficulty bands, response contract and arithmetic workload are preserved.

grading.details: All 1,690 native checks pass, including wrong choices and stale counterfactual answers. The source contract is radio-only.

rendering.details: All 21 actual-UI renders pass; nine screenshots were inspected.

packaging.details: Relocation, deterministic replay, exact dependencies, parameter rejection and bounded resampling pass. Package hashes remain unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Relevant and irrelevant controls behave correctly. The prior shortcut solves 0/5 runner items; no tested surface strategy solves the whole batch. Finite-audit and captured-inventory limits are documented.
